algolia.name: Beats by Dr. Dre - Beats Mixr On-Ear Headphones - Neon Green
algolia.description: Enjoy incredible sound with these Beats by Dr. Dre Beats Mixr GREENNEON MIXR on-ear headphones, which feature 40mm drivers that deliver a low frequency range for smooth mids and highs. The rotating earcups allow for single-ear monitoring and a snug fit.
